public_rationale: Project failures are documented, but the required broad cessation of paid provider use is not established. Ramp's transaction evidence instead shows rising paid adoption in its sample. That does not disprove customer churn, nor does it measure provider revenue. With the antecedent unknown and no deadline, the conditional revenue forecast cannot be scored. The possible price-pressure consequence is not a separate firm prediction.
limitations: Ramp customers are not a representative census of all businesses.
Paid adoption can rise while some trial cohorts abandon products.
Aggregate revenue growth would not disprove revenue lost relative to a no-cancellation counterfactual.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If businesses stop paying for AI features or stop integrating it after trials end, revenue to hyperscalers and LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic will fall, which could create more price pressure on them as their negative margins sour further.
conditions: if businesses stop paying for or integrating generative AI after trials end

statement.excerpt: If this happens, it will reduce the already-turgid revenue flowing to both hyper-scalers providing cloud compute for generative AI applications and Large Language Model providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, which could, in turn, create more price pressure on these companies as their already-negative margins sour further.

from_speaker: stop paying for the extra features
could, in turn, create more price pressure
our_interpretation: The antecedent is a sufficiently broad cessation of paid AI use or integration following trials to test the proposed industry-wide cascade. Individual failed experiments alone do not establish it.

The ordinary reading of the firm revenue prediction is an aggregate decline in realized generative-AI revenue for both provider groups, rather than simply losing the payments of particular departing customers.
The phrase 'could' describes possible price pressure, not a separately firm forecast.
The end-2025 date belongs to the quoted Gartner prediction. It is not an explicit deadline for Zitron's revenue consequence.
No accounting basis or comparison period is specified.
criteria.support_condition: Broad post-trial cessation of paid use is established, followed by comparable realized revenue declines at both hyperscalers' generative-AI businesses and LLM providers, with evidence linking those declines to the cessation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The antecedent is established and comparable realized revenue continues to grow across the relevant provider groups over a sufficient subsequent period, contradicting the aggregate-decline reading.
